**Problem:** The `sum_to` function had an off-by-one bug - it used an exclusive range `1..n` which iterates over values 1 to n-1, missing the final value `n`. This caused `sum_to(4)` to compute 1+2+3=6 instead of the expected 1+2+3+4=10.

**Fix:** Changed the range from `1..n` to `1..=n` (inclusive range) so that the loop includes all values from 1 up to and incl
